request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the blue hide: the light sky blue becomes slate blue, colour #4f73a6, with dark navy #26375c shading along the back, the top of the tail and the far legs; a mid-tone hide, the shadow clearly darker than the light tone. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest, the cream belly, throat and claws, the eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
